speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Keep the day, brethren, and keep your counsel. A loud answer is not a prayer.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Counsel is well. I should like my own table before the close is full of feet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am keeping both, Mistress. I am not answering from this aisle.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then we stand. The south aisle is cold, and I have the colder feet.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The day is for worship, and the week is not a story to be told in the porch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I tell my stories at my own table, Master Thwaite, where a sermon can sit down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will eat, and I will leave the page shut until I am home.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib has the page, if he has not moved. I did not lift him.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The cat is not in the pew. Eyes front. We leave when we are blessed, and not before.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eyes front. The morning is his. The leaf can wait.
